items.question: How long do solar panels last?
items.answer: Solar panels can operate for 25-30 years. We provide a 25-year warranty.

items.question: Do they work in winter?
items.answer: Yes, solar panels work in winter too. However, if snow covers the panels, efficiency may decrease.

items.question: How much space is needed?
items.answer: Approximately 6-8 m2 is needed per 1 kW system. A residential system typically requires 20-40 m2.

items.question: What is the budget?
items.answer: Residential systems range from 2-5 million MNT, while business systems range from 5-20 million MNT.
